title: backlog.py dispatch --resume ID sends a stopped or returned worker back with a message and moves its run state, so no orchestrator resumes a session by hand
goal: backlog.py dispatch --resume ID --message FILE resumes the worker session of the item's last dispatch (claude -p --resume, detached, the worker env and caps) and moves the run key to working and then to returned or failed as dispatch does

run: import subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','dispatch','-h'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(0 if r.returncode==0 and '--resume' in r.stdout else 1)

import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys, json, glob
R = os.getcwd(); T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
bin_dir = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()); out_dir = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp())
SESSION = '-'.join(['1' * 8, '2' * 4, '3' * 4, '4' * 4, '5' * 12])
with open(bin_dir + '/claude', 'w') as f:  # a stub for the headless session: records how it was started
    f.write('#!/bin/sh\npwd -P > "$OUT/cwd"; echo "$KB_ROLE" > "$OUT/role"; cat > "$OUT/stdin"\n'
            'printf "%s\\n" "$@" > "$OUT/argv"\necho \'{"session_id": "' + SESSION + '", "is_error": false}\'\n')
os.chmod(bin_dir + '/claude', 0o755)
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S, OUT=out_dir, PATH=bin_dir + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
sys.path.insert(0, R + '/_tools')
import bl_dispatch
def sh(*a, cwd=None): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd or T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
g = lambda *a: sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', *a)
g('init', '-q', '-b', 'main', '.'); shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
bl = lambda *a: sh(sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, *a)
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
sp = re.search(r'SP-\w+', bl('new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)
iid = re.search(r'ST-\w+', bl('new', 'story', '--title', 'Planted', '--goal', 'g', '--touch', 'kb/public/x.txt',
                              '--check', 'python3 -c pass').stdout).group(0)
for f in glob.glob(T + '/kb/_self/backlog/*.json'):
    d = json.load(open(f, encoding='utf-8'))
    if d['id'] == sp: d['status'] = 'active'
    if d['id'] == iid: d['status'] = 'doing'; d['sprint'] = sp
    json.dump(d, open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=2)
open(T + '/.gitignore', 'w').write('.claude/worktrees/\n_cache/\n')
g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'planted')
wt, scratch = bl_dispatch.worktree_path(T, iid), bl_dispatch.scratch_path(T, iid)
g('worktree', 'add', '-q', '-b', 'work/' + iid, str(wt))
scratch.mkdir(parents=True)  # the last dispatch: its session's JSON and the ledger record of its session
(scratch / bl_dispatch.RESULT_NAME).write_text(json.dumps({'session_id': SESSION, 'is_error': False}))
bl_dispatch.record_worker(T, iid, worker_session=SESSION)
for s in ('claimed', 'working', 'returned'): c('transition', 'run/' + iid, '--to', s)
msg = os.path.join(out_dir, 'message.md'); open(msg, 'w').write('landing stopped at checks: fix the failing check\n')
r = bl('dispatch', '--resume', iid, '--message', msg)
read = lambda n: open(os.path.join(out_dir, n)).read() if os.path.exists(os.path.join(out_dir, n)) else ''
argv = read('argv').split()
states = [e['fields'].get('state') for e in json.loads(c('wait', '--since', '0', '--timeout', '0', '--kind', 'progress', '--item', iid).stdout)['events']]
ok = (r.returncode == 0 and '--resume' in argv and argv[argv.index('--resume') + 1:][:1] == [SESSION] and '-p' in argv and '--max-turns' in argv
      and read('stdin') == open(msg).read() and read('role').strip() == 'worker' and read('cwd').strip() == os.path.realpath(str(wt))
      and states[-2:] == ['working', 'returned'] and '"returned"' in c('get', 'run/' + iid).stdout)
print('dispatch --resume', r.returncode, (r.stdout + r.stderr).strip()[-160:], '| argv', argv[:6], '| states', states)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Retrospective of SP-hja7yu5k: ST-fb7nlvke's landing stopped at checks, the orchestrator resumed the worker with a hand-built claude -p --resume (env KB_ROLE and KB_OPERATOR, caps, detached Popen) and moved the run key with coord.py transition (refused to working, then returned) because only dispatch moves it. The check only reads the help text for the flag: a planned item adds a planted run with a stub claude. Planning 2026-10-24: premise ran on today's base: the help-text check and the added planted check (a stub claude on PATH; dispatch --resume ID --message FILE) both fail (--resume unrecognized). Plan: dispatch --resume reads the session of the last dispatch (worker_session of the claims ledger, else result.json in the scratch directory), runs claude -p --resume SESSION in the item's worktree with the message file on stdin, the worker env (KB_ROLE worker, KB_OPERATOR) and the same caps, moves the key to working and then returned or failed, and works with --detach. kb-sprint skill text (skills/sprint/SKILL.md, shown as .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md, protected: staging copy and stage-back) tells the orchestrator to resume with dispatch --resume instead of a hand-built claude -p --resume. The stub in the check also answers 'claude auth status', which dispatch calls for the operator id. Correction: skills/sprint/SKILL.md is the real file (.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md is a link to it), so its change needs no staging copy. Planned into SP-dx76osrn on 2026-10-24, last in the order.
